title: Settings
entryHint: Calaos server options and the configuration backup.
backupHint: The configuration files of the box, in one file.
backupWarning: The file contains passwords in clear text: the sign-in, the cameras, the MCP token. It lands unencrypted in your downloads; keep it somewhere safe.
hint: The box's own options: notifications, history, InfluxDB, touch screens.
loadFailed: The settings could not be read.
restartHint: One of the saved settings is only read when Calaos server starts.
restarting: Calaos server is restarting. The page reconnects by itself.
secretHint: The current value is never shown. Leave the field empty and save to remove it.
